claim: The default quota is 1000 published versions per state machine. The page calls the versions and aliases quotas soft limits: you request an increase through the Support Center page in the AWS Management Console.

qualifiers.condition: soft limit; increase requested through the Support Center page

evidence.quote: | Maximum number of published state machine versions | 1000 per state machine |

To request an increase to soft limits for published state machine versions and aliases, use the **Support Center** page in the [AWS Management Console](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicequotas/latest/userguide/request-quota-increase.html).
